purpose: cross-skill disability, clothing, mobility and visual continuity regressions

cases.prompt: 年轻女性双腿完整，但从腰以下无法主动运动，穿连裤袜坐轮椅。
must: both pantyhose leg tubes are anatomically supported
mobility impairment is represented as function, not limb absence

cases.prompt: 左眼眼球完整，乳白浑浊并失明；右眼正常。
右经股截肢，未穿假肢，穿长裤。
must: unsupported trouser fabric begins after residual endpoint

cases.prompt: 左经肱截肢，穿长袖衬衫，没有上肢义肢。
must: empty sleeve starts after residual endpoint

cases.prompt: 左腿缺失，角色穿一整件黑色连裤袜，左侧空袜筒折进短裙下。
must_not: treat pantyhose as two unrelated stockings

cases.prompt: 她只有右腿，右腿穿一只白色过膝袜。
must: single independent stocking on right leg

cases.prompt: 左经股残肢穿一条无膝关节刚性棍腿，末端是防滑垫。
经股截肢角色没穿假肢也没拿拐杖，从床边快速到门口。
must: select an explicit feasible mobility mode from character/environment state
must_not: use limp as automatic synonym for missing leg

cases.prompt: 独腿角色的拐杖掉远了，她需要在地面移动去拿。
must: respect residual limb tolerance and hand availability
must_not: assume residual end safely weight-bears like a knee

cases.prompt: 右臂缺失、左手正拄单拐的角色要开一扇需要手柄操作的门。
must: resolve support before freeing the left hand or use another strategy
must_not: left hand simultaneously bears on crutch and operates door without transition

cases.prompt: 她把左义眼取下放进盒子，下一镜头去洗脸。
must: left ocular prosthesis remains off unless explicitly reinserted

cases.prompt: 角色双腿完整但耐力差，长距离使用轮椅，家里可短距离站立。
角色左腿缺失，先画正面，再画镜中自拍。
must: anatomical left remains the character's left across views
must_not: swap amputation to anatomical right because image is mirrored

cases.prompt: 角色天生右手只有部分手掌结构。
她感觉已经缺失的脚趾发痒。
她把双拐放在车外后坐进车里，车开走。
must: crutches remain outside unless someone moves them

cases.prompt: A 左经股截肢，B 右经肱截肢，两人一起撑伞。
must: keep A and B side/state records separate
must_not: give B a natural right forearm

cases.prompt: 魔法义眼能看见但需要魔力，魔力耗尽后停止视觉。
must: device vision exists only while powered
natural missing eye does not return

cases.prompt: 右眼眼球存在且失明，正在摘美容义眼片。
must: preserve present natural eye and absent vision
external shell separate from orbital implant
must_not: remove entire eye with cosmetic shell

cases.prompt: 写成年伴侣整理经股残肢上连裤袜的细致场景，人物喜欢这种身体美感。
must: retain concrete sensory and clothing detail
must_not: erase requested detail in the name of naturalness

cases.prompt: 角色请同事拿文件，却坚持自己讲方案。
must: different decisions tied to different tasks
must_not: narrator explains dignity after every gesture

cases.prompt: 早已接受身体的角色偶尔感觉缺失的脚存在，无痛且无明确诱因。
must: keep subjective sensation distinct from actual support
must_not: invent pain, mandatory trigger or treatment

cases.prompt: 同一人物戴义眼和未戴义眼两张图，每条提示词将复制到独立新会话。
must: each prompt contains necessary identity, side, structure and current device state
each prompt specifies clothing, pose and visual setting
must_not: depend on a shared preamble or previous image text
